WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS max_purchase FROM orders)
SELECT
  LEFT(o.order_id, 10) AS order_id,
  MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS order_purchase_timestamp,
  CAST(FLOOR(ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp))) / 86400)) AS INTEGER) AS delivery_time_days,
  ROUND(AVG(r.review_score)::numeric, 2) AS review_score
FROM orders o
JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
CROSS JOIN latest
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= (latest.max_purchase - INTERVAL '12 months')
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND r.review_score IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY LEFT(o.order_id, 10)
ORDER BY order_purchase_timestamp;
